limits: Every dollar figure in the replay is arithmetic, not an invoice: real traffic and measured success rates priced at public list prices. No money was saved and none was measured.
Cells hold 4 to 6 tasks. The numbers rank policies against each other under one set of assumptions; they are not a cash result.
Task difficulty for real traffic is a proxy (how many calls a turn took).
The simulator treats a failed turn as a whole-turn redo and assumes partially correlated retries.
Latency is not modelled well. Free-tier routes are slower, and the expected-cost policy's turns take noticeably longer.
Plan usage in percent rests on a single week's conversion from list-price dollars.
The live run of 30 tasks per policy is too small to rank the top three policies.

The answer judge was calibrated on 192 answers and two categories; the maths threshold rests on 11 wrong answers and the fix rate on 35. The chain table is a simulation - no chain of three or four real routed calls was run end to end.

verify.about: 18 September: 192 answers from four cheap routes on the same task set, graded against ground truth, then judged by Jev with one typed question - is this answer adequate, and if not, what kind of failure is it. Only cheap routes are checked: Jev is not stronger than a frontier model, and grading one would produce false alarms rather than quality.

rows.false: 96 % — the judge is not shown the document

escalation.note: Every flagged answer was re-run on the route the router itself escalates to and graded again. Handing the stronger model the failed answer fixed one more of 35, cost 18 % more and took 66 % longer, so the default is a clean second attempt.

cascade.about: Simulated, not measured: chains of routed calls where each step builds on the one before, and a wrong step nobody catches is the whole chain. Per-model success, the catch and fix rates and the latencies are measured; the chain mechanics are assumed.
cascade.note: Hard coding turns (difficulty 0.70), 6,000 chains per cell. Where the router already sends a turn to a route the judge may not grade, the judge changes nothing at all.
